[Sir](../persons.html#2407)-
Being unfortunately absolutely unmusical I am afraid I can say nothing to the purpose, except that I heartily congratulate you and the pupils of the College on lending glory and beauty to Divine service.

Yours truly
C. M.

Yonge

[^1]: Along with a number of other public figures CMY had been asked by Curwen, the editor of the Musical Herald, to endorse the work of the Tonic Sol-fa College, which promoted the use of that system in the teaching of singing.
